global_vision.positioning: A high-end educational foundation (Malhar) that seamlessly blends Islamic tradition with modern secular education. Rejects typical 'mosque flyer' or generic template aesthetics in favor of an Awwwards-level, type-led editorial layout.
core_principles: Content is King: Treat typography like art. Text isn't just information; it's the primary visual element.
Controlled Contrast: Expressive serif headlines paired with highly readable sans-serif body text.
Intentional Asymmetry: Break out of generic centered containers. Use overlapping modules and split-screen layouts.
Premium Motion: Scroll-triggered parallax, silky smooth Lenis scrolling, and line-by-line staggered reveals.

background.description: Warm Off-White/Cream. Never use pure white. Gives a physical, paper-like editorial feel.

text.description: Deep Charcoal for high legibility and refined contrast.

brand.description: Deep Emerald/Teal acts as the dramatic structural color (dark sections, hero overlays). Warm Gold/Brass acts as the delicate accent (thin borders, active states, numbered chapters).

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-[5vw] font-light tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
scales.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#C5A059]

rules: Never center-align paragraphs. Default to left alignment for a strong editorial edge.
Use 'Amiri' exclusively for decorative Arabic calligraphy, set in large sizes with low opacity, or small elegant bismillah/salam openers.
Headings should use extreme tracking contrast: tight for Serifs, loose for Sans-serif overlines.

visual_enhancers.geometric_patterns: Use SVG Islamic geometric patterns (8-point stars) as section dividers or background textures at extremely low opacity (3% to 5%) over Cream or Emerald backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #1A1A1A/10 (light mode) or #C5A059/20 (dark sections). Used to create 'magazine grid' lines.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for the sticky nav. High blur (backdrop-blur-xl), high opacity (bg-[#F9F8F6]/80), crisp 1px bottom border.
visual_enhancers.photography: Spotlighted subjects. Use 'clipped frames' (images that don't stretch full width but sit inside a 1px border container with padding). Black and white or desaturated tones with a warm color grade.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Rely on 1px borders for structure (The 'Technical Grid' look) to keep it modern and flat.

motion_language.scrolling: MANDATORY: Lenis smooth scroll for weight and premium momentum.
motion_language.reveals: Hero H1 must be wrapped in `overflow-hidden` blocks and revealed line-by-line using Framer Motion (`y: 100%` -> `y: 0`, ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1]).
motion_language.parallax: Use GSAP ScrollTrigger or Framer Motion `useScroll`. Images inside clipped frames should move slightly slower than the page scroll.
motion_language.marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee`. Low contrast, extremely slow drift. Content: 'Malhar Educational Trust • Empowering Generations • Tradition meets Tomorrow • '
motion_language.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards scale the image slightly (1.05) while keeping the container fixed. Buttons use a 'swipe' fill effect.

layout_strategy.spacing: Exaggerated. Use `py-24` to `py-32` for standard sections. Allow text to breathe.
layout_strategy.grid: Bento Grid protocol Mode A (Tetris Grid) for Marketing. Create asymmetry. 12-column foundation.
layout_strategy.containers: Max width `max-w-7xl` centered, but let imagery break out to the edges occasionally.

components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism nav. Top ultra-thin utility bar (Deep Emerald bg, white text, phone/email). Main nav (Cream glass, charcoal text, Logo left, links center, 'Donate' button right).
components.buttons: Primary: Solid Deep Emerald (`bg-[#0A4D3C] text-white hover:bg-[#135B4A]`), sharp corners or slight rounding (`rounded-md`). Secondary: Outline with Gold/Brass (`border-[#C5A059] text-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#C5A059] hover:text-white`).
components.cards: Flat, bento-style. 1px border (`border-black/5`). Generous internal padding (`p-8`). Image on top/side with crisp edges.
components.stats: Large numerals using a counting animation (react-countup). Placed in a 4-column border-separated grid.

homepage.layout: Min-height 90vh. Split layout. Left: Large H1, staggered reveal. Right: Parallax image inside an elegant arched or rectangular frame. Two CTAs ('Explore Institutions', 'Admission'). Background: Cream with subtle Islamic geometric texture.
Full width, slow-moving text strip. Gold background, Emerald text.
4-column grid. Large Serif numbers ('150+', '4200'). Subtitles in Sans-serif.
Split section. Left: Sticky founder portrait (Sheikh Sayyid Umarul Farooq Al Bukhari) in B&W. Right: Numbered chapters detailing the vision, using Gold numerals (01, 02, 03) and Serif headings.
Bento grid displaying the 7 institutions. High-density photography with dark overlay gradients.
Large 16:9 container, perfectly centered, with a custom 'Play' button overlay triggering the YouTube embed in a cinematic modal.
Grid of faculty. Elegant, desaturated portraits. Name in Serif, Role in Sans-serif overline.
List-view for events (date on left, title on right with bottom borders). Card-view for News.
3-column minimalist icon block. Use elegant, thin-line icons (Phosphor).
Horizontal scroll preview or classic masonry grid. Hover reveals zoom effect.
Deep Emerald background, gold typography. Large CTA.
Massive typography. 'Malhar' taking up 80% width. Grid of links. Deep Emerald background, Cream text.

instructions_to_main_agent: For the custom fonts, import 'Newsreader', 'Work Sans', and 'Amiri' from Google Fonts in the index.html or global CSS.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the custom color palette (emerald, gold, cream, charcoal) and custom fonts.
Do NOT use typical Shadcn 'Card' components for the main marketing grid unless heavily customized to remove standard Vercel shadows/radii. Rely on raw HTML/Tailwind for bento and editorial layouts.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta-button"`).
Avoid arbitrary centering. Keep text blocks left-aligned for an authoritative, editorial feel.
Set up pages structure (hybrid fullstack) with basic React Router or Next.js app router depending on environment.
Ensure the hero text reveal is executed via an `overflow-hidden` wrapper around each text line, animating the child element's Y transform.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do NOT center align app containers.
Do not use dark colors as standard gradients. Use solid colors with texture.
NEVER use generic placeholder images or emoji icons. Only use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Ensure WCAG AA contrast ratios, especially for Gold text on Cream, and Cream text on Emerald.
Create depth through staggered motion and overlapping components, NOT through heavy drop-shadows.
